description: Seerr's own version stays a human-reviewed pull request: its patch releases can carry database migrations that run unattended and forward-only on the next restart (v2.5.1 -> v2.5.2 added two TypeORM schema migrations, v2.7.0 -> v2.7.1 added a settings migration), so `//patch-automerge` is deliberately not extended here.

`versioning=semver` on the annotation in defaults/main.yml is what keeps the version list honest: of the 381 tags ghcr.io/seerr-team/seerr publishes, strict semver keeps only the real vX.Y.Z releases and discards `latest`, `develop`, the floating `v3` / `v3.4` aliases and the `preview-*`, `sha-*` and `sha256-*` noise.
